title: To Beach or Not to Beach
section_path: To Beach or Not to Beach
section_path_text: To Beach or Not to Beach
summary:
The uncertain future of vessel recycling
Benjamin Franklin once said "in this world nothing can be said to be certain, except death and taxes". In the world of shipping, only half of this statement is generally true. Most shipowners worldwide have historically managed to avoid paying taxes, but merchant vessels do have a finite lifespan.
